sections.html: Riverton is a Salt Lake County city in the southwestern corner of the valley, about 20 miles south and a bit west of Salt Lake City. Its 12.58 square miles lie at 4,439 feet, with South Jordan to the north, Draper to the east, Bluffdale to the south and Herriman to the west. Because it is in Salt Lake County, property tax, appeals and deed recording all run through county offices in Salt Lake City.

sections.h2: How a farm town became a suburb
sections.html:
Riverton began in the mid-1850s as a farming settlement, probably first claimed by Archibald Gardner, and was originally called Gardnerville. Residents raised alfalfa, wheat, sugar beets, tomatoes, poultry, sheep and dairy cattle, and Jordan Valley Bank started here in 1905 as a community bank. Electricity arrived in 1912, and the Salt Lake and Utah Railroad (Orem Line) ran through from 1914 to 1945.

The city incorporated in the late 1940s. A 1996 annexation nearly doubled its size, and Herriman's incorporation in 2000 fixed the western boundary. The old Riverton Elementary School became the Riverton Community Center and City Hall by 2005 to 2006.

Riverton is heavily owner-occupied, so most sales are family houses on streets where the neighbors own too. The 2020 count was 45,285, up 16.9% from 38,753 in 2010, and the July 1, 2025 estimate is 47,395.

Several named areas began as particular developments.

  • Tithing Yard Hill is a residential planned development named for a former LDS tithing storage site.
  • Foothills was annexed in the 1980s, de-annexed after the developer's bankruptcy and re-annexed in 1996.
  • Riverton City Park occupies the site of the former City Hall.

The city grew in pieces, so a house's age depends heavily on which part of town it is in.

The main roads are Bangerter Highway, the Mountain View Corridor and Redwood Road, and drivers reach Interstate 15 by 12300 South or Bangerter. Bangerter Highway (SR-154) enters Riverton as it curves north, crossing 13400 South, 12600 South and 11400 South, and the 12600 South interchange opened on May 19, 2022. Transit is limited: UTA Route 126, which started in April 2025, runs hourly along 12600 South. The average commute is 24.8 minutes.

sections.h2: Which school district is Riverton in?
sections.html:
Jordan School District covers Riverton, along with Bluffdale, Copperton, Herriman, South Jordan and most of West Jordan. It had 57,866 students and 67 schools in 2021 to 2022, after the east-side communities left to form Canyons School District in 2009.

  • Elementary: Foothills, Midas Creek, Riverton, Rosamond, Rose Creek and Southland
  • Middle: Oquirrh Hills and South Hills
  • High: Riverton High School

Attendance boundaries do not follow city limits, so many Riverton students go to school in neighboring cities. Confirm a specific address with the district before you tell a buyer where their children would go.

The city's planning page offers an accessory dwelling unit application and an owner-occupancy affidavit, both submitted at City Hall. Short-term rentals go through a conditional use permit and an occupancy declaration. Check the current ordinance before you describe an apartment in your Riverton house as legal. The state allows cities to require a business license for short-term rentals but not to act against someone only for listing a rental online.

Salt Lake County mails a Notice of Valuation and Tax Change in late July. The Board of Equalization takes appeals from August 1 through September 15, and the deadline is 45 days from the notice or September 15, whichever is longer.

  • File online, by mail with form BE01, or in person at 2001 South State Street, Suite N3-300, Salt Lake City.
  • Include evidence, such as at least three comparable sales within the year before January 1, a signed settlement statement or a fee appraisal.
  • You can appeal only the total market value, not land or improvements separately.
  • The Board can change the valuation but not the tax you pay.

A hearing officer reviews the evidence, and the county reviews appeals around October 1 unless the State Tax Commission extends it. Taxes are due November 30 whether or not a decision has arrived. A further appeal goes to the Utah State Tax Commission within 30 days of the county decision. The appeals office is at 385-468-7200.

The Wasatch Fault is about 240 miles long, and the segment under Salt Lake City produced a major earthquake roughly 1,200 to 1,300 years ago. Quakes of magnitude 7 or larger recur every 900 to 1,300 years on any one central segment, and a magnitude 5.7 quake on March 18, 2020, just north of Magna caused moderate damage. Riverton averages 15.76 inches of precipitation a year, with winter snow and summers that sometimes top 100 degrees. An inspector may look at foundations and chimneys, and as-is sellers do not have to repair what the inspector finds.

sections.h2: A basement apartment and the sale
sections.html: Plenty of family houses here have a finished basement that someone rents. Before you talk to buyers, find out whether the unit went through the city's application and owner-occupancy affidavit. If it did, keep copies, because a lender will ask. If it did not, say so plainly and let the buyer decide how to proceed. Hiding a unit tends to surface at inspection, which is a worse moment to have the conversation.

Taxes are due November 30 even while an appeal is pending, so a sale that closes in the fall should account for the current bill. The title company can show how it is divided between you and the buyer. For the signing, bring a photo ID, the deed or estate documents for an inherited home and a payoff figure if a loan remains. Funding and recording follow once both sides have signed.

sections.h2: Selling a Riverton house for cash
sections.html:
Calls come about inherited family homes, houses with a basement apartment that lacks paperwork and moves on a short deadline. You tell us about the property, we review it, and we make an offer based on condition.

We buy as-is, so you do not repair or stage. A title or escrow company handles the closing and the deed is recorded with the county. Salt Lake County has its own recorder, so confirm recording details with your closing agent. Heirs should settle who can sign before the closing, and if a mortgage remains, the payoff comes out of the proceeds. If our offer is not what you hoped, you can decline it and keep your options open.

faqs.q: What county is Riverton, Utah in?
faqs.a: Riverton is in Salt Lake County, in the southwest corner of the valley. Salt Lake County handles its property tax and appeals.

faqs.q: When is the deadline to appeal Riverton property taxes?
faqs.a: The Board of Equalization accepts appeals from August 1 through September 15. The deadline is 45 days from the notice or September 15, whichever is longer.

faqs.q: When are Riverton property taxes due?
faqs.a: Taxes are due November 30, whether or not you have received an appeal decision.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Riverton house with an unpermitted basement apartment?
faqs.a: Yes. We buy houses as they are. A conventional buyer might ask for proof the unit was approved through the city's application and owner-occupancy affidavit, and a cash sale avoids that step.
Riverton is in the Jordan School District. Many students attend schools in neighboring cities because attendance boundaries do not match the city limits.
